audited_source_corrections.action: Kept striking the match as the strengthened antecedent in outer space.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The first outer-space sentence says ‘light this match,’ although the displayed inference and model strengthen ‘strike this match’ by adding ‘in outer space.’
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முன்கூற்றிலும் விளக்கத்திலும் விண்வெளியில் தீக்குச்சியை உரசுவதாகவே கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Changing the antecedent to the conclusion that the match lights, which would no longer illustrate antecedent strengthening.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The formal pattern is p implies r versus (p and q) implies r, where p is striking and q is being in outer space.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is striking, rather than lighting, the action strengthened by the outer-space condition?

audited_source_corrections.action: Removed the duplicated ‘be’ from the second premise and conclusion.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Both quoted sentences say ‘would have been be a traitor.’
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு இடங்களிலும் நாட்டுத்துரோகியாக இருந்திருப்பார் என்று இயல்பாகக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Representing the duplicated auxiliary as meaningful content.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The intended English phrase is uniquely ‘would have been a traitor.’
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are both quoted traitor clauses grammatically complete?

audited_source_corrections.action: Removed the negation slash from satisfaction of q material-implies r throughout the q-admitting sphere.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The prose says q material-implies r is true at all worlds in S-prime and uses that to infer q counterfactually-implies r, but the satisfaction macro carries a negation slash.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் முறைசார் குறியீடும் உரையும் இரண்டிலும் அந்தப் பொருள்சார் நிபந்தனை மெய் என்று கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the negation slash, which would destroy the second premise of the counterexample.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: At w1 both q and r are true, and at w q is false, so q material-implies r is true throughout the sphere.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is q material-implies r satisfied throughout S-prime?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the metadata comment from transitivity to contraposition.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The file name, identifier, title and contents concern contraposition, while the Section comment says transitivity.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மெட்டாதரவு உள்ளடக்கத்திற்கேற்ப எதிர்மறைநேர்மாற்றுப் பகுதியைக் குறிக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating a nonfunctional copied comment as the authoritative section identity.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Every functional locator identifies the contraposition section.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the metadata comment name contraposition?

audited_source_corrections.action: Indexed the displayed sphere system by its center world w.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The sphere-model definition makes O a function and O_w the sphere system at w, but this example equates O itself with one set of spheres.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எடுத்துக்காட்டு w மையத்திற்கான கோள அமைப்பை O_w என்று தருகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating O as a constant sphere system contrary to the chapter definition.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: All neighboring examples specify O_w when only the evaluation world's sphere system is given.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the displayed set assigned to O_w?

audited_source_corrections.action: Used the introduced model M_1 in both satisfaction claims.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The example introduces M_1 but its two concluding satisfaction statements use an undefined M.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரு நிறைவுறுத்தல் கூற்றுகளிலும் அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்பட்ட M_1 ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Renaming the introduced model to M, which would alter the explicit model label rather than repair its later references.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Both claims evaluate the model just constructed and diagrammed.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both satisfaction statements refer to M_1?
